releaseStatus.note: RAV 2.5.7 is the current public release. It adds a Machine ID row in the About window, the MCP rav_entitlement_status tool (56 tools total), and on-demand analysis reports (HTML, Markdown, PDF) on activated installations; it rebuilds file inspection on RF Parser 2.5.14 so large files inspect in about a second, and fixes the timeline scrubber (drag pauses and seeks exactly, authored speed and ping-pong direction are followed, frame-aligned ruler, stable readout width).

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV is a desktop Rive animation viewer and exporter with timeline, still-image, animated-image, live interaction recording, bundled verified encoders, and MCP access.
